title: Track current pixel density and EXIF dimensions per image request
body: Track current pixel density and EXIF dimensions per image request `current pixel density` and `preferred density-corrected dimensions` describe a fetched image, but they are stored on the `img` element. Once an `img` has both a `current request` on screen and a `pending request` loading, one per-element slot can't serve both: - A new `pending request` overwrites the density of the image still being shown, changing `naturalWidth`/`naturalHeight` before the new image is available (#5607). - Re-selecting a `partially available` URL at a new density returns early without updating it, so the image loads with the stale density; browsers already update it (#13049). - `density-corrected natural width and height` mutates the stored EXIF dimensions on every read, and they are never cleared, so a later non-EXIF image inherits them. - `last selected source` is only recorded without `srcset`/`picture`, so in responsive mode every environment change re-fetches the same source (#5060). This moves both fields onto `image request` and keeps them in sync in the selection algorithms: - Set `current pixel density` when an `image request` is created or taken from the `list of available images`; update it on the `current request` (clearing any `pending request`) or `pending request` when their URL is re-selected at a new density. - Make `density-corrected natural width and height` return a fresh width/height pair, and reset the stored dimensions when a request is aborted or prepared for presentation. - Record `last selected source` whenever a source is selected, and reset it (with density 1) when nothing is selected, so `react to changes in the environment` only fetches on a real change. Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64903. Fixes #5060. Fixes #5607. Fixes #13049. --- - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium (already implements #5060 and #13049; #5607 pending) * Gecko (already implements #5060 and #13049; #5607 pending) * WebKit (already implements #5060 and #13049; #5607 pending) - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64903 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: https://issues.chromium.org/issues/584147744 * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2091380 * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=330918 * Deno (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, module resolution, web workers, and web storage): N/A * Node.js (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, and module resolution): N/A - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
